proposal: Convert garage to a home office and widen the vehicle crossover

pages.text:
Site: 3 Kestrel Lane, Eastmere
Dwelling: detached, 4 bedrooms
Proposal: garage conversion to home office; crossover widened from 3.0 m to 4.8 m
Parking after works: two spaces side by side on the drive; cycle store in the rear garden

Kestrel Lane is a 20 mph street serving 11 houses with no through traffic.
The authority confirms the visibility splay requirement can be waived for this crossover.
